text_block_list.text:
With the cheers of the fans at her back, 
she ran the Takarazuka Kinen to the very 
end. Though she narrowly lost—

Having brought smiles to so many in the 
audience, she was finally able to become 
the "blue rose" she had sought for so 
long.

After finishing her race, Rice Shower 
expressed her wish to run in the Arima 
Kinen alongside Mihono Bourbon and Mejiro 
McQueen.

Just like the Takarazuka Kinen, the Arima 
Kinen is a race where only the most 
popular Umamusume chosen by fan voting can 
compete.

Seeing Rice Shower now able to say she 
"wanted to run" in such a race without 
hesitation, the Trainer truly felt how 
much she had grown.
